lines: rested in consciousness: through its door,
outside in body up to liṅga-sthaṇḍila-image,
the whole path stands firmly fixed.
Melting that whole path into the body,
the body into prāṇa, that into mind,
that into void — in that consciousness,

c1_essence: The whole path fixed through door-to-image in consciousness; melting path-body-breath-mind-void, full-consciousness attained; the beyond-portion offered — hence prakriyā-knowledge-endowed is required.
